age.evidence: The study was carried out on male ICR mice (30.0 ± 2.0 g). Only body weight reported; age not stated.

sex.evidence: The study was carried out on male ICR mice

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (PSIL): 4.4 mg/kg dissolved in the vehicle... Additional experiments were performed with a DSER dose of 1500 mg/kg (and PSIL 1.5 mg/kg)... Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection
D-seine (DSER) 3000 mg/kg... Additional experiments were performed with a DSER dose of 1500 mg/kg
D-Cycloserine (DCS) 320 mg/kg dissolved in the VEH... DCS doses 22.2 mg/kg, 176.19 mg/kg, and 440.47 mg/kg

handling.evidence: No specific handling protocol described beyond acclimatization week.

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-h light/dark cycle (phase of testing not specified)

assays.assay_description: Electromagnetic detection of head twitches via ear-tag magnets in a magnetometer apparatus immediately after i.p. injection; recorded over 20-30 min. Tested with psilocybin alone and in combination with DSER or DCS at multiple doses.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection

setup_habituation.evidence: After a 7-day recovery period, the ear-tagged animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus immediately after IP injection

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed inside the magnetometer apparatus; no restraint during recording is described. Restraint was only used briefly for ear tag placement, not during recording.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in magnetometer apparatus during recording (standard short test).

water_restriction.evidence: No water in magnetometer apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: placed inside a magnetometer apparatus immediately after IP injection

sample_size.evidence: Fig. 1A: F = 15.33, df 3, 34 (~38 animals across 4 groups); Fig. 2A: F = 39.10, df 3, 36 (~40 animals). Exact per-group n not stated.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1.5 and 4.4 mg/kg) significantly increased HTR vs vehicle. DSER and DCS alone had no effect. Co-administration of DSER (1500 or 3000 mg/kg) completely attenuated HTR; DCS dose-dependently reduced HTR with complete block at 440.47 mg/kg.
outcomes.evidence: PSIL (4.4 mg/kg) induced a significant increase in HTR compared to vehicle control (p < 0.0001)... The combination of PSIL and DSER completely attenuated HTR... A combination of PSIL and DCS 440.47 mg/kg completely blocked HTR

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of head twitches recorded as the sole outcome.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Reported as total HTR over 20-30 min; no within-session time course.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: A custom MATLAB script processed the magnetometer signal to detect current peaks; this is signal peak-detection, not video-based behavioural classification.

E6_spatial.evidence: Magnetometer is a single recording chamber.

D2_session_duration.evidence: HTR over 30 min; HTR over 20 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: HTR performed on a single day per animal.

assays.assay_description: Mice received vehicle, PSIL, DSER, DCS, or combinations i.p.; 30 min later MK-801 (0.5 mg/kg) i.p.; 30 min after that placed in 50x50x40 cm open field for 60 min. Total distance traveled measured via EthoVision XT-17.

application_type.evidence: Mice were injected intraperitoneally with VEH, PSIL 4.4 mg/kg, DSER 3000 mg/kg, DCS 320 mg/kg or combinations

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed individually in the center of the open field and allowed to freely explore; no prior apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore the apparatus for 60 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food in open field arena during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in open field arena during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: After 30 min, the mice were injected IP with MK-801 0.5 mg/kg, and 30 min later, they were placed in the open field arena

sample_size.evidence: Fig. 3A: df 3, 35 (~39); Fig. 3B: df 3, 28 (~32). Per-group n not explicitly stated.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin, DSER, or DCS alone did not significantly affect MK-801-induced hyperlocomotion. Combined PSIL+DSER and PSIL+DCS each significantly reduced MK-801-induced hyperactivity vs MK-801+vehicle.
outcomes.evidence: Mice treated with PSIL + DSER prior to MK-801 had a statistically significant reduction in hyperlocomotion compared to MK + VEH... the combination of PSIL and DCS significantly reduced the MK-801-induced hyperactivity

B1_num_measures.evidence: The total distance traveled (centimeters) was measured.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total distance over 60 min reported; no within-session time-course.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Ethovision XT-17 Video Tracking System (position tracking, on SCORE-0 list).

E1_environment_type.evidence: open field apparatus (50x50x40 cm) with white walls and black floor

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were placed individually in the center of the open field.

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to freely explore the apparatus for 60 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Hyperactivity test on a single day.

judge_notes: Two assays retained: HTR and MK-801-induced hyperactivity (open field). All three candidates agreed on these.
Excluded Western blot of synaptic proteins (GAP43, PSD95, synaptophysin, SV2A) as it is a molecular/biochemical endpoint, not a behavioural assay.

B7 (automated classification) for HTR: gptoss scored 1 citing the custom MATLAB script, but the script processes a magnetometer current signal (peak detection) rather than classifying behavioural states from video. Rubric examples for score 1 are pose estimation/MoSeq/SimBA/supervised ML video classifiers. Scored 0 in agreement with qwen and glm.
B1: counts of head twitches and total distance are each single behavioural measures; scored 0 per rubric (1 measure -> 0 points).

time_to_assay for MK-801 open field: time since LAST drug administration is 30 min (MK-801 was injected 30 min before recording start), which falls in acute_0to2h. Used 60 min as time from psychedelic pretreatment; either way bin is acute_0to2h.
